Agent memory (MAPLE-Guard shows one poisoned write is retrieved repeatedly and promoted into shared memory with no malicious message crossing a visible edge — gating the lifecycle cuts attack success 38.2% → 0.9%; Tencent Cloud stakes the team-level memory hub; V-Mem routes retrieval by modality)

Agent memory (three papers on the same day attack the write path rather than the read path — MemArbiter arbitrates admission at decision time instead of write time, MemArena benchmarks what an on-device assistant must remember across months rather than across a long context, and O(1) SSM state injection replaces context stuffing for edge retrieval; mem0 at 62.6k surfaces as the strongest untracked repo in the category)
